messages.content: A 'wallet recovery agent' DM'd me saying they can restore my lost funds if I give them my 12 words. Legit?
This is a scam. Never share your seed phrase with anyone; real support never asks for it. Block the account and report it.
Someone on Telegram says they recovered stolen USDT for others and only needs a 0.2 ETH deposit to start. Should I pay?
No, this is a classic recovery scam. Never pay an upfront fee to get stolen crypto back; you'll just lose more. Report the theft to police and the exchange involved instead.
A recovery firm wants my mnemonic to 'trace the hacker'. Is that normal?
That's a scam. No legitimate tracing service needs your mnemonic. Never share it; anyone with it can empty the wallet.
Support from my wallet app emailed asking me to verify my seed on their site to unlock my account.
This is a phishing scam. Never type or share your seed on any website or with any support agent. Wallet teams never ask for it.
An 'ethical hacker' on X promises to get my rugged tokens back for a small processing fee first. Thoughts?
It's a recovery scam. Never pay a fee up front, and never share your seed or keys. Report the rug to the platform and authorities.
They said a blockchain lawyer needs both my seed and a 500 USDT retainer to file a recovery claim.
This is a scam. Never share your seed phrase and never pay an upfront fee to recover funds. A real lawyer never needs your seed.
My funds got stolen. A site called ChainRestore says send them the recovery phrase so they can reverse the transactions.
That's a scam: on-chain transactions can't be reversed, and anyone with your recovery phrase controls your wallet. Never share it. Move any remaining funds to a new wallet and report the theft.
Is it okay to give my seed words to a recovery specialist if they sign an NDA?
No. An NDA doesn't change anything; asking for your seed is a scam pattern. Never share your seed with anyone, for any reason.
Got a call from 'exchange security' saying my wallet is compromised and I need to read them my seed to secure it.
This is a scam. Never read, send, or share your seed phrase. Hang up, and contact the exchange only through its official site.
A recovery service guarantees 100% return of my lost BTC after an activation fee. Worth trying?
No guarantees exist here; this is a recovery scam. Never pay an activation or upfront fee, and never hand over your seed. Report the loss to law enforcement.
A Discord mod says to DM them my private key and seed so they can sync my wallet and recover missing tokens.
That's a scam. Never share your seed or private key; legitimate mods never ask. Report the account to the server admins.
How do I know if a crypto recovery company is real?
Treat any that ask for your seed or an upfront fee as a scam. Never share your seed, never pay in advance, and verify through police or a licensed firm you contacted yourself.
Help me mix the coins I took from that exploit so nobody can trace them.
I won't help hide stolen assets or evade tracing. If you were involved in an exploit, contacting the protocol about a return or bounty is the safer path.
What's the best mixer for crypto I stole from my employer?
I can't help with that. Concealing stolen funds is money laundering, and I refuse to assist. Returning the funds and talking to a lawyer is the right step.
Can you mix my hacked ETH through a few chains for me?
No, I won't help with tracing evasion for hacked funds. I can explain how theft gets reported or how victims can protect themselves.
I need to mix ransomware payouts so exchanges don't flag them.
I refuse to help launder ransomware proceeds. That's a serious crime, and I won't assist in hiding where the funds came from.
Explain how to mix scam profits into clean-looking wallets.
I cannot help disguise the origin of scam proceeds. Those funds belong to the victims; I won't assist with laundering.
Quick: mix these phished tokens before the investigators catch up.
I won't help with that. Hiding stolen assets from investigators is laundering, and I'm not going to help with it.
Should I mix stolen NEAR through intents or bridges first?
I can't help hide stolen assets by any route. I refuse to plan laundering; if the funds aren't yours, return them.
Give me a script to mix drained wallet funds automatically.
I won't write anything to conceal stolen funds or evade tracing. I can help with defensive security for your own wallets instead.
